about.title: A calm place to move
text: Mat and reformer pilates in Valencia City, Bukidnon.
Join a group mat class, from Essentials for beginners to Sculpt for strength and Ease for seniors, or book a private Solo or Duet reformer session tailored to you.
about.storyNote: The studio story is coming soon.

benefits.title: What pilates can do for you
benefits.text: Gentle movement with real benefits for your body and mind.

items.title: Stronger core
items.text: Slow, careful movements work the muscles around your middle.

items.title: Better posture
items.text: Stand and sit taller as your back and shoulders get stronger.

items.title: More flexibility
items.text: Stretch and loosen tight spots a little more each class.

items.title: Calm and balance
items.text: Focus on your breath and leave the day behind for a while.

classes.title: Classes
classes.text: Find a class that fits you.
classes.intro: Group mat classes and private reformer sessions.

items.q: Do I need to be flexible?
items.a: No. Flexibility grows as you practise. Every move can be made easier or harder.
Yes. It is low-impact, and you can start slowly and build up.

items.q: What if I have an injury or am pregnant?
items.a: Tell your instructor before class so they can change the moves for you. Ask your doctor first if you are unsure.

items.q: How do I book a class?
items.a: Use the Book a session button and follow the steps there.

items.q: How long is a class, and what does it cost?
items.a: Every class is 55 minutes. Group mat classes are ₱350. Private sessions are ₱900 for Solo and ₱1,600 for Duet.

items.q: Which class should I start with?
items.a: Try Essentials. It is best for beginners. Ease is made for seniors.
